data.one_liner: Add turn-by-turn navigation to your Flutter app using Mapbox.
data.what_it_does: Integrates Mapbox turn-by-turn navigation directly into Flutter applications for Android and iOS. It supports real-time routing, traffic avoidance, voice and banner instructions, and customizable UI views or embedded widgets.
use_when: You need full turn-by-turn driving, cycling, or walking directions inside your app.
You want to display embedded navigation views within your widget tree.
avoid_when: You only need basic static maps without navigation or routing.
You do not want to configure native Mapbox API tokens and download credentials.
strengths: Provides a full-fledged turn-by-turn navigation UI ready to drop in
Supports multiple waypoints and live event listeners for navigation progress
Includes natural-sounding turn instructions and day/night map styles
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration of Mapbox access tokens and gradle/Info.plist properties
Offline routing is currently listed as a TODO
data.setup_notes: Requires Mapbox accounts, download tokens in .netrc (iOS) and gradle.properties (Android), location permissions, background mode configurations, and modifying MainActivity to extend FlutterFragmentActivity.
